# MediPrimer

> Free, independent, plain-language guide to U.S. health coverage: Medicare,
> Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, the ACA Marketplace, and CHIP. No ads, no
> plan recommendations, no lead sales. Written at an 8th-grade reading level
> and maintained continuously against official sources (medicare.gov,
> cms.gov, ssa.gov, medicaid.gov); every fact carries a source annotation.

Every page is available in English, Spanish (/es/), and Traditional Chinese
(/zh-Hant/), with more languages launching; the same complete guide in each.

- [Turning 65: Start Here](https://mediprimer.org/turning-65.html)
